sub_strands.sub_strand: Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh (Theme 1: Mapishi)
learning_experiences: kutambua silabi za sauti lengwa kutokana na maneno kwenye vitabu, ubaoni au kwa kutumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia,
kusikiliza silabi za sauti f/v, s/z, l/r na th/dh zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali (k.v. kinasasauti),
kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa akiwa na wenzake,
kusikiliza vitanzandimi vinavyotungwa kutokana na maneno yenye sauti lengwa vikikaririwa (k.m. shirika la reli la Rwanda larejelea shughuli zake rasmi),
kutunga vitanzandimi vinavyotokana na sauti husika akiwa peke yake au katika vikundi,
kutunga vitanzandimi kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali na kushirikiana na wenzake kuvirekebisha,
kusakura mtandaoni ili kupata vitanzandimi zaidi vyenye sauti lengwa.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua maneno gani yenye silabi zinazokangany a kimatamshi?
Je, unajua vitanzandimi gani vyenye silabi zinazokangany a kimatamshi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana katika kutamka silabi na kutunga vitanzandimi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza sauti na kuunda vitanzandimi mtandaoni.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotamka kwa usahihi silabi zinazotokana na sauti lengwa na kutunga vitanzandimi sahihi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu vitanzandimi atakavyotunga vyenye sauti lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutunga vitanzandimi vinavyotokana na sauti husika.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anpotunga vitanzandimi na kuvirekebisha ifaapo akiwa na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Kujithamini: mwanafunzi anapounda na kutamka vitanzandimi vilivyo na sauti lengwa.
Masuala mtambuko anuwai: kutokana na vitanzandimi vinavyoelekeza utoaji wa maelezo kuhusu masuala hayo kama vile utunzaji wa mazingira, ujuzi wa matumizi ya fedha, afya bora na utunzaji wa wanyama.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha matamshi bora ya sauti.

outcomes.text: kutambua silabi zinazotokana na sauti zinazokaribiana katika maneno: f/v, s/z, l/r na th/dh
kutamka silabi zinazotokana na sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi: f/v, s/z, l/r na th/dh ili kutofautisha matamshi yake
kutamka vitanzandimi vinavyoundwa kwa silabi za sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi: f/v, s/z, l/r na th/dh ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
kutunga vitanzandimi vyenye maana kutokana na sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi: f/v, s/z, l/r na th/dh)
kuchangamkia kukariri vitanzandimi vinavyotungwa kwa silabi za sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi: f/v, s/z, l/r na th/dh) ili kuimarisha matamshi yake

learning_experiences: kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa (k.v. vyakula, viungo vya kupikia, njia za kupika na vifaa vya kupikia) kwa kutumia kadi maneno, chati, mti maneno au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kushiriki katika vikundi kujadili na kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa katika sentensi,
kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwenye kitabu au kwenye tarakilishi akiwa peke yake au katika vikundi,
kutoa muhtasari kuhusu kifungu alichosoma,
kujibu maswali kutokana na kifungu alichosoma,
kusoma vifungu mtandaoni kuhusu suala lengwa na kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu ujumbe ulioyomo.
key_inquiry_questions: Kusoma kuhusu mapishi kuna umuhimu gani?
Ni hadithi gani umewahi kuisoma kuhusu mapishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusoma kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni ili kusoma vifungu zaidi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za vikundi.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoziheshimu kazi za wenzake kwenye kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Masuala ya afya: mwanafunzi anapojifunza kuhusu mapishi.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu vinavyoeleza kuhusu mapishi.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha usomaji kwa ufahamu na matumizi ya msamiati kimuktadha na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha usomaji kwa ufahamu. Mwanafunzi pia atatumia ujuzi wa kupambanua ujumbe katika ufahamu anaposoma makala yanayomhitaji kufahamu katika masomo mengine yote.

outcomes.text: kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumika katika kifungu ili kuimarisha ufahamu
kutumia msamiati lengwa kwa usahihi katika sentensi
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, matukio na wahusika
kuonyesha uelewa wa kifungu kwa kutoa muhtasari na kujibu maswali
kujenga mazoea ya usomaji bora katika maisha ya kila siku

skills.name: Elewa maana ya msamiati katika kifungu
skills.mastery: Works out what a word means from the passage it is in, and picks the right word for a gap, and does not choose a look-alike word or a word from a nearby sentence, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

skills.name: Elewa ujumbe, matukio na wahusika wa hadithi
skills.mastery: Answers who, where, what happened and what the main message is from a short story, and puts events in order, without using outside knowledge or a detail from the wrong place, in 8 of 10 new questions.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word in the passage.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the first letters and not the meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: A word with a look-alike among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the sentence around the word and think what is being done.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana ya neno hutokana na sentensi lilimo, si na jinsi linavyofanana na neno lingine.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word from a nearby sentence that is not about this word.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child grabs the first thing the passage says.
misconceptions.reveals: An option taken from another sentence.
misconceptions.help: Go back to the exact sentence with the word.
misconceptions.feedback: Rudi kwenye sentensi lenyewe lenye neno hilo. Maana inatoka hapo, si kutoka sentensi ya karibu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks the opposite of the word.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child finds the idea and then reverses it.
misconceptions.reveals: An option with the opposite meaning.
misconceptions.help: Does the word mean the same thing as your choice?
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha neno si maana yake. Soma tena sentensi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives another character for who did it.
misconceptions.cause: The child remembers several names and joins them.
misconceptions.reveals: A who-question with another character as an option.
misconceptions.help: Find the sentence with the action and see who did it.
misconceptions.feedback: Rudi kwenye kifungu uone ni nani hasa alifanya kitendo hicho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers from what the child knows, not from what the passage says.
misconceptions.cause: The child answers a Kenyan child's common meal rather than the one in the passage.
misconceptions.reveals: A question whose answer is not the usual one.
misconceptions.help: Underline the answer in the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu liko katika kifungu. Tumia kilichoandikwa, si kile unachokijua kutoka nyumbani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a small detail as the main message.

example.question: Ujumbe mkuu wa hadithi ni upi?

misconceptions.cause: The child chooses a sentence that is easy to find.
misconceptions.reveals: A main-message question with a detail as one option.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Hadithi nzima inatufundisha nini?"
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe mkuu ni funzo la hadithi nzima, si jambo moja dogo ndani yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts events in the order they are told in the question, not in the story.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not go back to the story.
misconceptions.reveals: Ordering four events from the story.
misconceptions.help: Find each event in the story and see which came first.
misconceptions.feedback: Matukio hupangwa kwa jinsi yalivyotokea katika hadithi. Soma tena kila tukio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a detail from the passage that belongs to another part of the story.
misconceptions.cause: The child remembers many details and joins the wrong ones.
misconceptions.reveals: A what-or-where question with another detail of the passage as an option.
misconceptions.help: Find the exact sentence with the action in the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Kifungu kinataja vitu vingi. Rudi kwenye sentensi sahihi ujue jibu linalolingana na swali.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua insha ya wasifu kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kusoma vielelezo vya insha ya wasifu vilivyoandikwa katika matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya wasifu,
kushirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi ili kubainisha na kujadili vidokezo vifaavyo vya mada lengwa,

kuaandika insha ya wasifu isiyopungua maneno 150 inayohusu mada lengwa (k.v. Mpishi nimpendaye) kwa kuzingatia, anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, kanuni za kisarufi (k.v uakifishaji mwafaka na tahajia) na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu inayojumuisha methali, tashbihi na nahau alizojifunza awali,
kuandika insha ya wasifu mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili kumpa motisha kuandika zaidi,
kumwonyesha mzazi au mlezi wake insha ya wasifu aliyoandika ili apate maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Insha ya wasifu inahusu nini?
Unazingatia nini unapoandika insha ya wasifu?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya wasifu.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya wasifu.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
Uadilifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya wasifu kuhusu watu ambao wanajulikana kwa matendo mema.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya afya na kujikinga: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi pamoja na wenzake katika vikundi anajifunza mambo ya afya.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha uandishi wa insha mbalimbali.

outcomes.text: kutambua insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia mtindo na muundo wake
kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa ubunifu ili kujenga maelezo yenye kutoa picha dhahiri
kufurahia kutunga insha bora ili kuimarisha mazoea ya kuandika

skills.name: Tambua insha ya wasifu, masimulizi na maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells a short text that describes a person (wasifu), one that tells events in order (masimulizi) and one that explains how something is done or what it is (maelezo), in 8 of 10 new short texts.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Takes a text that describes a person (wasifu) for a story (masimulizi).

example.question: Kifungu kinaelezea sura, tabia na maisha ya mtu. Ni insha ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both kinds can mention a person.
misconceptions.reveals: Short texts: one describing a person, one telling events.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the text tells what happened in order, or tells who someone is.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya wasifu humwelezea mtu: sura yake, tabia yake na maisha yake. Masimulizi husimulia matukio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a text that explains how something is done (maelezo) for a story.

example.question: Kifungu kinaeleza hatua za kupika uji. Ni insha ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child sees a sequence in both.
misconceptions.reveals: A recipe-like text and a story.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the writer says "what happened" or "how to do it".
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo au jinsi ya kufanya kitu. Masimulizi husimulia tukio lililotokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a story of events for a description of a person.

example.question: Kifungu kinasimulia kilichotokea Jumamosi kijijini. Ni insha ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: A story has a person in it.
misconceptions.reveals: A story about a person doing things.
misconceptions.help: Does the text tell events in order?
misconceptions.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio kwa mpangilio. Wasifu humwelezea mtu mwenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua nomino za pekee (k.v. Kisumu, Mei, Rabuka, Alhamisi na Yohana) kwenye tarakilishi, kapu maneno, mti maneno, kadi maneno au chati,
kutaja nomino za pekee akiwa na wenzake kama vile za majina ya mji, majina ya mito, majina ya watu na majina ya miezi,
kutambua nomino za pekee katika sentensi kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi, chati kwa kuzipigia mstari au kukolezea rangi,
kujaza nafasi kwenye sentensi au kifungu kwa kutumia nomino za pekee,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino za pekee akiwa na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Nomino za pekee zinahusu nini?
Ni nomino zipi za pekee unazozijua?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi za vikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua nomino za pekee.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia nomino za pekee.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua nomino za pekee na kuzitungia sentensi sahihi.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi ya vikundi.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini wenzake wakitaja nomino za pekee.
sub_strands.pcis: anuwai kutokana na sentensi zinazoelekeza utoaji wa maelezo kuhusu masuala hayo k.v. usalama, utunzaji wa mazingira, afya bora na utunzaji wa wanyama.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kutambua na kutumia aina za maneno kama vile nomino za kipekee.na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha utambuzi na matumizi ya aina mbalimbali za maneno ikiwemo nomino za kipekee.

outcomes.text: kutambua nomino za pekee kwenye sentensi au vifungu vya maneno
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino za pekee ili kukuza matumizi ya lugha sahihi
kuchangamkia matumizi ya nomino za pekee katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia nomino za pekee
skills.mastery: Picks the proper noun (the particular name of a person, place, river, school, month) from a sentence and uses one to fill a gap, and does not choose a common noun, a job title or the first word of the sentence, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Picks the general name of the kind of thing (mto, nchi, mji) where the particular name (Tana, Kenya, Nairobi) is needed.

example.question: Mto ___ ni mrefu kuliko mito yote nchini Kenya.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the word is a noun but not that a proper noun is the one particular name.
misconceptions.reveals: A question with a name and a general noun as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Kuna mito mingi, mto huu unaitwa nani?" Names point to one only.
misconceptions.feedback: Neno hilo ni jina la jumla la kitu cha aina hiyo. Nomino ya pekee ni jina la kipekee, kama Tana au Nairobi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a job or title (mwalimu, daktari, mkulima) as a proper noun because it names one person.
misconceptions.cause: A title sounds like a name when one person holds it.
misconceptions.reveals: Options with a title and a given name.
misconceptions.help: Many people can be called mwalimu. A name belongs to one person.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwalimu ni cheo au kazi, na watu wengi wanaweza kuwa walimu. Jina la mtu, kama Kamau, ndiyo nomino ya pekee.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks the first word of the sentence only because it starts with a capital letter.

example.question: Mwalimu alimpa Wanjiru kitabu. Nomino ya pekee ni ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the capital letter as the only sign of a proper noun.
misconceptions.reveals: A sentence that starts with a common noun and has a name in the middle.
misconceptions.help: Every sentence starts with a capital. Ask which word is the name of one person or place.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi huanza kwa herufi kubwa, hata kama neno la kwanza ni nomino ya kawaida. Tafuta jina la mtu au mahali.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

learning_experiences: kutambua nomino za kawaida kwenye kadi au kapu la maneno (k.v. mtu, mtoto, darasa, ukuta, mwalimu, meza na kiti),
kutaja akiwa na wenzake nomino za kawaida,
kutambua nomino za kawaida katika sentensi kwa kuzipigia mistari au kuzikolezea rangi kwenye tarakilishi,
kutumia nomino za kawaida kujaza nafasi kwenye sentensi,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino za kawaida akiwa peke yake au kwenye vikundi.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vitu gani vipatikanavyo katika mazingira yako?
Ni vitu gani vinavyotumi wa katika mapishi mbalimbali?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi na kujaza nafasi.
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kutaja nomino na kutunga sentensi.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kwenye vikundi.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wengine kwenye kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa: mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi.
Masuala mtambuko anuwai kutokana na sentensi zinazotoa maelezo kuhusu masuala hayo k.v. utunzaji wa mazingira, afya bora na utunzaji wa wanyama.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kutambua na kutumia aina za maneno kama vile nomino za kawaida na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha utambuzi na matumizi ya aina mbalimbali za maneno ikiwemo nomino za kawaida.
sub_strands.design_notes: Second read left this for a person to confirm: no lessons figure.

outcomes.text: kutambua nomino za kawaida kwenye sentensi au vifungu vya maneno
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino za kawaida ili kukuza matumizi sahihi ya lugha
kufurahia kutumia nomino za kawaida katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia nomino za kawaida
skills.mastery: Picks the common noun (the general name of a kind of person, place, animal or thing) from a sentence and uses one to fill a gap, and does not choose a name, a verb or an adjective, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Picks a name (Juma, Mombasa) when asked for the common noun.

example.question: Chagua nomino ya kawaida: "Juma alienda Mombasa kwa basi."

misconceptions.cause: The child looks for any noun and takes the first one.
misconceptions.reveals: A sentence with names and one common noun.
misconceptions.help: Ask which word could name many buses, not one named person or place.
misconceptions.feedback: Juma na Mombasa ni majina ya pekee. Nomino ya kawaida ni jina la jumla la aina ya kitu au mtu, kama basi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a verb or an adjective as the common noun.

example.question: Mtoto mdogo analia. Nomino ni ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child has not yet fixed what a noun is: a name of a person, place, animal or thing.
misconceptions.reveals: Options that mix a noun, a verb and an adjective.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Ninaweza kusema huyu ni nani au hiki ni nini?"
misconceptions.feedback: Neno hilo si nomino. Nomino hutaja mtu, mahali, mnyama au kitu. Kitenzi hutaja kitendo, na kivumishi huelezea nomino.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

sub_strands.sub_strand: Maamkuzi na Maagano (Theme 2: Huduma ya kwanza)
learning_experiences: kutambua maamkuzi (k.v. shikamoo, Habari za utokako? Habari za adhuhuri? Habari za jioni?) kutoka kwenye chati, ubao au vifaa vya kidijitali, michoro na picha,
kushiriki kujadiliana na mwenzake au katika vikundi maamkuzi yanayolengwa na matumizi yake,
kutambua maagano (k.v. lala salama, safari njema, alamsiki) kutoka kwenye chati, ubao au vifaa vya kidijitali, michoro na picha,
kushirikiana na wenzake kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano lengwa,
kutazama watu wakiamkuana na kuagana katika vifaa vya kidijitali,
kuambatanisha maamkuzi na maagano na majibu sahihi.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, watu husalimiana vipi katika jamii?
Je, watu huagana vipi katika jamii?

skills.name: Tumia mpangilio wa maneno katika kamusi
skills.mastery: Puts words in dictionary (alphabetical) order, looking at the second and third letter when the first letters match, and finds the word that comes first or comes next, in 8 of 10 new lists.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Puts words in order of length, not alphabet.

example.question: Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?

misconceptions.cause: The child looks for the shortest or the first-looking word.
misconceptions.reveals: Words of different lengths.
misconceptions.help: Say the alphabet and look at the first letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Kamusi hupanga maneno kwa herufi za alfabeti, si kwa urefu wa neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Looks only at the first letter and picks any word with the same first letter.

example.question: Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?

misconceptions.cause: The child stops at the first letter when two words begin the same.
misconceptions.reveals: Words that begin with the same letter.
misconceptions.help: When the first letters match, look at the second letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno yanapoanza kwa herufi moja, tazama herufi ya pili, kisha ya tatu: sahani huja kabla ya samaki.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the end of the alphabet first.

example.question: Neno gani huja mwisho kwenye kamusi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes first and last.
misconceptions.reveals: A question that asks for the last word.
misconceptions.help: A comes first and Z comes last.
misconceptions.feedback: Alfabeti huanza na A na kuishia na Z. Neno la mwisho kwenye kamusi huanza na herufi ya mwisho zaidi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

kuandika insha isiyopungua maneno 150 inayosimulia kisa kuhusu jinsi ya kutoa huduma ya kwanza barabarani kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,

Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi.

skills.name: Tambua na tumia nomino za wingi
skills.mastery: Gives the plural of a noun in the classes ki-vi, m-wa, m-mi, ji-ma and n (kitabu-vitabu, mtoto-watoto, mti-miti, jiwe-mawe, kalamu-kalamu) and uses it in a sentence, without leaving the noun unchanged or putting on the wrong prefix, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Leaves the noun unchanged where the plural changes it (kitabu for vitabu).

example.question: Kitabu kimoja, vitabu viwili. Andika wingi wa "kitabu".

misconceptions.cause: In English most plural markers come at the end; here the prefix changes.
misconceptions.reveals: A plural gap where the singular is an option.
misconceptions.help: Ask which part of the word shows "many".
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa nomino nyingi hubadilisha mwanzo wa neno, si mwisho. Kitabu kimoja, vitabu viwili.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Puts the wrong plural prefix on the noun (watabu for vitabu, vitoto for watoto).
misconceptions.cause: The child learned one prefix and uses it for every noun.
misconceptions.reveals: Plurals from two classes in one question.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Mtoto ni mtu au kitu?" People take wa-, things like kitabu take vi-.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiambishi cha wingi hutegemea ngeli ya nomino. Watu hupewa wa- (watoto), na vitu kama kitabu hupewa vi- (vitabu).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Adds a plural prefix to a plural form or doubles it (wawatoto, vivitabu).
misconceptions.cause: The child tries to be sure it is plural and adds the prefix twice.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap where a doubled form is an option.
misconceptions.help: Say the word aloud and ask if one prefix is not enough.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino ina kiambishi kimoja cha wingi tu. Mti mmoja, miti miwili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua na tumia nomino za vitenzi-jina
skills.mastery: Tells a verbal noun (kusoma, kucheza, kulima: the verb with ku- used as a noun) from an ordinary verb or the doer noun, and uses it in a sentence, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the bare verb stem (soma, cheza) where the verbal noun with ku- is needed.
misconceptions.cause: The child reads the stem as the noun.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap with the stem and the ku- form as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask which word can start the sentence like a noun (it begins with ku-).
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino ya kitenzi-jina huanza na ku-: kusoma, kucheza, kulima. Shina la kitenzi peke yake haliwezi kuwa nomino hapa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a conjugated verb (anasoma) as the verbal noun.
misconceptions.cause: The child sees a verb and does not tell it apart from the verbal noun.
misconceptions.reveals: A conjugated verb among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the word says who is doing it and when.
misconceptions.feedback: Anasoma ni kitenzi chenye mtu na wakati. Kitenzi-jina ni kusoma, kinachotumika kama nomino bila mtu wala wakati.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the doer noun (msomaji, mkulima) for the action noun.
misconceptions.cause: Both words come from the same verb and look alike.
misconceptions.reveals: The doer noun among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the gap names the action or the person who does it.
misconceptions.feedback: Msomaji ni mtu anayesoma. Kitenzi-jina hutaja kitendo chenyewe: kusoma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua vitendawili
skills.mastery: Picks the kitendawili (riddle) from a methali, a nahau and an ordinary sentence, and gives the answer to a known riddle, in 8 of 10 new items. Setting and guessing riddles aloud (outcome b) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Takes a methali for a riddle.
misconceptions.cause: Both are short sayings.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle and a methali.
misconceptions.help: A riddle asks a hidden question and waits for the answer.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitendawili huficha jibu na humtaka mtu kukitegua. Methali hutoa funzo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a nahau for a riddle.
misconceptions.cause: Both can be a short phrase.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle and a nahau.
misconceptions.help: Can you guess an answer to it?
misconceptions.feedback: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana maalum. Kitendawili huuliza kwa mafumbo na kina jibu la kutegua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes an ordinary sentence for a riddle.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not see that a riddle hides the thing it describes.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle and a plain sentence.
misconceptions.help: Does the text name the thing, or hide it?
misconceptions.feedback: Kitendawili hakitaji kitu moja kwa moja; hukielezea kwa fumbo. Sentensi ya kawaida inataja wazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a thing that shares one detail with the riddle but is not the answer.
misconceptions.cause: The child picks the first thing that comes to mind.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle with plausible answers.
misconceptions.help: Test each answer against every part of the riddle.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu la kitendawili lazima lilingane na kila sehemu yake. Hiyo si jibu sahihi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha
skills.mastery: Names what a fluent reader does (clear sounds, a fitting speed, a fitting voice, a pause at the koma and the kikomo) and does not take speed or loudness for fluency, in 8 of 10 new items. Reading a passage aloud at a fitting speed, with the voice and signs (outcomes c to e) is judged by a teacher listening.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Takes fast reading for fluent reading, or very slow reading for careful reading.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: Si haraka sana wala polepole sana

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks the best reader is the fastest.
misconceptions.reveals: A question on speed with extremes as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the listener can follow every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Kusoma kwa ufasaha si kusoma haraka sana. Kasi ifaayo ni ya wastani, ili msikilizaji aelewe kila neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a loud voice for a fitting voice.

example.question: Sauti ipasavyo wakati wa kusoma ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: Sauti inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks louder is better.
misconceptions.reveals: A question on the voice with shouting and whispering as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the voice is clear and comfortable to listen to.
misconceptions.feedback: Sauti ipasavyo ni ile inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele wala kunong'ona.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on without a pause at the koma and the kikomo.

example.question: Ukifika kwenye koma wakati wa kusoma, ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads word after word and does not use the marks.
misconceptions.reveals: A question on the pause at a koma or a kikomo.
misconceptions.help: Read the sentence aloud and listen to where the voice rests.
misconceptions.feedback: Alama za uakifishi zinatuonyesha mahali pa kupumzika: kidogo kwenye koma na kwa muda mrefu zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua sehemu mbalimbali za tarakilishi za kupigia chapa. (k.v. kipanya na kiwambo/ mulishi),
kutumia tarakilishi kuandika maneno au sentensi zinazolenga msamiati wa mapambo (k.v. herini, vipuli, pete, kipini, bangili, shanga, taji, kugesi na hina),
kutumia tarakilishi kuandika kifungu kinachohusisha mapambo mbalimbali,
kuhifadhi kazi yake kwenye faili ya tarakilishi mara kwa mara,
kuhariri kazi yake kwenye tarakilishi akishirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi,
kutuma kazi yake kwa mwalimu ili kuitathmini,
kuendelea kufanya mazoezi ya kuandika kwa kutumia tarakilishi akisaidiwa na mzazi/mlezi wake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni sehemu zipi za tarakilishi unazojua
Tarakilishi hutuwezesha kufanya kazi gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi za vikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kuandika na kuhifadhi kazi yake.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia ipasavyo vyombo vya kidijitali kama kipakatalishi na rununu.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapohariri kazi yake kwenye tarakilishi akishirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapohifadhi vyombo vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya maendeleo endelevu: mwanafunzi anapotumia ujuzi wa kidijitali ya kisasa kufanikisha uandishi. Uhusiano wa Masomo Mengine: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kuandika kwa tarakilishi na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha kuandika kwa tarakilishi, ujuzi unaoweza pia kutumiwa katika ujifunzaji wa masomo mengineyo.
sub_strands.design_notes: Second read left this for a person to confirm: links: not in the design.

outcomes.text: kutambua sehemu mbalimbali za tarakilishi zinazotumika kupigia chapa
kutumia tarakilishi ili kujenga maarifa ya kidijitali
kujenga mazoea ya kutumia tarakilishi kuandika na kuhifadhi maandishi

skills.name: Tambua sehemu za tarakilishi zinazotumika kupigia chapa
skills.mastery: Names the parts of a computer used to type (kibodi, kipanya, skrini, kitengo kikuu, kichapishi) and what each does, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Confuses the parts of the computer (kipanya for kibodi, skrini for kitengo kikuu).

example.question: Sehemu ya kupigia herufi ni ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child has used the computer but does not know the names.
misconceptions.reveals: Names of the parts and what each does.
misconceptions.help: Which part has keys with letters?
misconceptions.feedback: Kibodi ina vitufe vya herufi vya kupigia chapa. Kipanya hutumika kusogeza kielekezi, na skrini huonyesha kilichoandikwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong job for the part (kichapishi shows the screen).
misconceptions.cause: The child knows the word but not what it is for.
misconceptions.reveals: A part and its job.
misconceptions.help: A kichapishi prints on paper.
misconceptions.feedback: Kichapishi huchapisha kwenye karatasi. Skrini ndiyo huonyesha maandishi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua nomino za makundi katika chati, kadi maneno, ubao, vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutumia nomino za makundi katika sentensi na kuziandika daftarini mwake,
kutumia nomino za makundi kutunga sentensi mtandaoni akiwa na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua maneno gani yanayotaja makundi ya watu na vitu?
Je, nomino za makundi hutumiwa vipi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi mtandaoni akiwa na wenzake.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojibu swali dadisi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutunga sentensi mtandaoni.
Uwazaji wa kina na utatauzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa zamu.
Umoja: anapotunga sentensi mtandaoni akiwa na wenzake.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapokamilisha kazi yake kwa wakati ufaao.
sub_strands.pcis: Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika vikundi vinavyojumuisha wanafunzi kutoka maeneo mbalimbali.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kutambua na kutumia aina za maneno kama vile nomino za makundi na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha utambuzi na matumizi ya aina mbalimbali za maneno ikiwemo nomino za makundi.

outcomes.text: kutambua nomino za makundi katika matini ili kuzibainisha
kutumia nomino za makundi katika sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
kufurahia kutumia nomino za makundi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia nomino za makundi
skills.mastery: Names the usual group noun for people and things (umati wa watu, jeshi la askari, msafara wa magari, mkungu wa ndizi, tita la kuni) and does not use one group word for every group or a single noun, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the group word of another group (jeshi for ndizi, umati for kuni).
misconceptions.cause: The child knows group words but not which one goes with which thing.
misconceptions.reveals: Group nouns for people, vehicles and fruit in one question.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Kundi hili ni la nini?" and think of the usual word.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila kundi lina jina lake la kawaida: umati wa watu, jeshi la askari, msafara wa magari, mkungu wa ndizi, tita la kuni.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks the name of one thing (mtu, gari, ndizi) where a group noun is needed.

example.question: Alipofika sokoni, aliona ___ wa watu wengi.

misconceptions.cause: The child looks for a noun that fits the topic and does not see that a group is meant.
misconceptions.reveals: A single noun among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the gap names one or many.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino ya kundi hutaja wengi kwa pamoja, kama umati wa watu. "Mtu" ni mmoja tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua nomino ambata (k.v. askarikanzu, mbwamwitu, mwanasiasa na mwananchi) kwa kutumia kadi maneno, kapu maneno, chati au vifaa vya kidijitali akiwa peke yake, au katika kikundi,
kujadili katika kikundi maana ya nomino ambata huku akitoa mifano,
kutumia nomino ambata katika sentensi na kuziandika katika daftari lake,
kutumia nomino ambata kutunga sentensi mtandaoni akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusakura mtandaoni ili kupata mifano zaidi ya nomino ambata na kuziandika katika daftari lake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua maneno yapi yanayounganishwa kuunda neno moja?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu nomino ambata.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni ili kupata mifano ya nomino ambata.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutunga sentensi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia nomino ambata.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutumia nomino ambata kutunga sentensi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapokamilisha kazi yake.
sub_strands.pcis: Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake katika shughuli za vikundi na kujifunza ukakamavu na kujiamini.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kutambua na kutumia aina za maneno kama vile nomino ambata na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha utambuzi na matumizi ya aina mbalimbali za maneno ikiwemo nomino ambata.

outcomes.text: kutambua nomino ambata katika matini ili kuzitofautisha na aina nyingine za nomino
kutumia nomino ambata kwa usahihi katika sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
kuonea fahari matumizi ya nomino ambata katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia nomino ambata
skills.mastery: Tells a compound noun (mwanafunzi, mwanahabari, mwanamichezo: nouns built from two words joined into one) from a simple noun and uses one in a sentence, and does not write it as two separate words, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Takes a long simple noun (mwalimu, daktari) for a compound noun.
misconceptions.cause: A long word looks as if it is built from parts.
misconceptions.reveals: Simple and compound nouns in one question.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the word is two words joined, such as mwana + funzi.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino ambata huundwa kwa kuunganisha maneno mawili, kama mwana + funzi = mwanafunzi. Mwalimu si ambata.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes a compound noun as two words (mwana funzi).
misconceptions.cause: The child sees two parts and writes them apart, as in English.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap where a split form is an option.
misconceptions.help: Say it as one word and write it as one word.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino ambata huandikwa kama neno moja: mwanafunzi, si "mwana funzi".
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

learning_experiences: kutambua nomino za dhahania (k.v. upendo, uhodari, ukweli) kwa kutumia kadi maneno, mti maneno, chati au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kujadili katika kikundi maana ya nomino za dhahania huku akitoa mifano,
kutumia nomino za dhahania katika sentensi na kuziandika sentensi hizo daftarini mwake,
kutumia nomino za dhahania kutunga sentensi mtandaoni akishirikiana na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua maneno yapi yanayotaja vitu ambavyo haviwezi kushikwa au kuonekana kwa macho?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano na wenzake kuhusu nomino za dhahania.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojadili katika kikundi maana ya nomino za dhahania na kutoa mifano.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutunga sentensi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kutumia nomino za dhahania kutunga sentensi.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotumia nomino za dhahania kutunga sentensi mtandaoni akishirikiana na wenzake.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapokamilisha kazi yake.
sub_strands.pcis: Kujithamini: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za vikundi hivyo atajifunza ukakamavu, stahamala na kujiamini.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kutambua na kutumia aina za maneno kama vile nomino za kidhahania na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha utambuzi na matumizi ya aina mbalimbali za maneno ikiwemo nomino za kidhahania.

outcomes.text: kutambua nomino za dhahania katika matini mbalimbali
kuelezea nomino za dhahania kwa kutoa mifano mwafaka
kutumia nomino za dhahania kwa usahihi katika sentensi
kuonea fahari matumizi ya nomino za dhahania katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua, eleza na tumia nomino za dhahania
skills.mastery: Picks the abstract noun (upendo, ukarimu, amani, furaha, uongo: an idea or feeling that cannot be touched), gives it from the person or verb it comes from, and uses it in a sentence, without choosing a thing or a verb, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Picks a thing that can be touched (mti, kitabu) as an abstract noun.
misconceptions.cause: The child has not fixed that an abstract noun is an idea or feeling you cannot touch.
misconceptions.reveals: A concrete noun and an abstract noun as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Ninaweza kuishika kwa mkono?" If yes, it is not dhahania.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitabu kinaweza kushikwa kwa mkono. Nomino ya dhahania haishikiki: ni wazo au hisia, kama upendo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the verb (kupenda, kuwa mkarimu) where the abstract noun (upendo, ukarimu) is needed.
misconceptions.cause: The verb and the noun come from the same idea.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap with a verb and its noun as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask which word can follow "wa" like a name of a feeling.
misconceptions.feedback: Kupenda ni kitenzi. Nomino ya dhahania inayotokana nacho ni upendo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the word for the person (mkarimu, mwongo) where the abstract noun (ukarimu, uongo) is needed.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not change m- (person) to u- (idea).
misconceptions.reveals: A gap where the person word and the idea word are options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Ni mtu au ni tabia?"
misconceptions.feedback: Mkarimu ni mtu mwenye tabia hiyo. Nomino ya dhahania ni ukarimu, yaani tabia yenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi katika maandishi,
kushiriki katika vikundi kuakifisha sentensi akitumia herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi (baadhi ya sentensi ziangazie suala lengwa),
kuandika sentensi akitumia herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi ifaavyo,
kuandika sentensi zenye herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini alama za kuakifisha hutumiwa katika maandishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika vikundi kuakifisha sentensi akitumia herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi akitumia herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi ifaavyo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi zenye herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali.
sub_strands.values: Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika vikundi kuakifisha sentensi akitumia herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi.
sub_strands.pcis: anuwai: kutokana na sentensi zinazotoa maelezo kuhusu masuala hayo kama vile utunzaji wa mazingira, upunguzaji wa Mikasa na zinazohusu suala la usalama.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kutambua na kutumia uakifishi wa aina mbalimbali na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha utambuzi na matumizi ya aina mbalimbali za uakifishi.

outcomes.text: kutambua herufi kubwa, alama ya koma, kikomo na kiulizi katika maandishi
kutumia herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi ifaavyo katika maaandishi
kufurahia matumizi ya herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi katika maandishi

skills.name: Tambua na tumia herufi kubwa, koma, kikomo na kiulizi
skills.mastery: Chooses the sentence with the right capital letter, koma, kikomo (full stop) and kiulizi (question mark), and finds the one mistake in a short note, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

misconceptions.error: Starts a sentence or a name with a small letter.
misconceptions.cause: Carelessness in a hurried hand or on a phone, or not seeing a name as a name.
misconceptions.reveals: Two sentences that differ only in the capital letter.
misconceptions.help: Look at the first letter of the sentence and of every name.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi huanza kwa herufi kubwa, na majina ya watu na mahali pia huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends a question with a kikomo (.) or a statement with a kiulizi (?).
misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the sentence as a question.
misconceptions.reveals: A question ended with a full stop and with a question mark.
misconceptions.help: Say it aloud: does your voice go up as if you ask?
misconceptions.feedback: Swali humalizika kwa kiulizi (?). Sentensi ya kawaida humalizika kwa kikomo (.).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the koma between things in a list or after a greeting word.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.
example.wrong_answer: Mama alinunua mchele sukari na chumvi.
example.correct_answer: Mama alinunua mchele, sukari na chumvi.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he speaks, without the pause.
misconceptions.reveals: A list written with and without koma.
misconceptions.help: Where would you pause when you read the list aloud?
misconceptions.feedback: Koma hutenganisha vitu katika orodha. Weka koma baada ya kila kitu isipokuwa kabla ya "na" ya mwisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes a common noun in the middle of a sentence with a capital letter.
misconceptions.cause: Habit from English headings or from names.
misconceptions.reveals: A sentence with a capital on a common noun.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the word is the name of one person or place.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi kubwa hutumika mwanzo wa sentensi na kwa majina ya pekee tu. Nomino ya kawaida katikati ya sentensi huandikwa kwa herufi ndogo.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

sub_strands.sub_strand: Maneno ya Heshima na Adabu (Theme 4: Saa na majira)
learning_experiences: kutambua maneno ya udugu (k.v. bwana, bibi, ndugu, binti, mama, mama mkubwa/mdogo, mjomba) kwenye ubao, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,
kueleza maana ya maneno lengwa kama yanavyotumiwa katika mahusiano ya kila siku kati ya watu,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia maneno lengwa kwa usahihi,
kutazama maigizo ya watu wakitumia maneno ya udugu kwenye tarakilishi na video,
kujadili matumizi ya maneno ya udugu akishirikiana na wenzake darasani,
kuigiza mazungumzo mafupi akiwa na wenzake huku akitumia msamiati wa udugu.
key_inquiry_questions: Kutumia maneno ya heshima kuna umuhimu gani katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi na video kutazama maigizo ya watu wakitumia maneno ya udugu.
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika maigizo yanayozingatia matumizi ya maneno ya udugu.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya udugu kuwasiliana.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya udugu kwa wenzake na kwa wakubwa wake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika maigizo mafupi.
Haki za kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya udugu katika mawasiliano.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kutambua na kutumia lugha ya heshima na adabu na somo la English na Religious Studies kwa sababu masomo haya hufundisha utambuzi na matumizi ya lugha ya heshima na adabu ili kuimarisha uhusiano baina ya watu.

outcomes.text: kutambua maneno ya heshima yanayohusiana na udugu yanayotumiwa katika mawasiliano
kutumia maneno ya heshima yanayohusiana na udugu kwa usahihi katika mazungumzo yake ya kila siku
kuthamini matumizi ya maneno ya heshima katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tambua maneno ya heshima ya udugu
skills.mastery: Names family relations and the greeting that shows respect (shangazi, mjomba, binamu, bibi, shikamoo, marahaba) and does not swap the mother's side and the father's side, in 8 of 10 new items. Using the words in daily talk (outcome b) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Swaps the father's side and the mother's side (shangazi and mjomba).
misconceptions.cause: The child knows the words but not the sides.
misconceptions.reveals: Relations from the father's and the mother's sides.
misconceptions.help: Shangazi is a woman (the father's sister); mjomba is a man (the mother's brother).
misconceptions.feedback: Dada ya baba ni shangazi. Kaka wa mama ni mjomba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Swaps the greeting and the reply (shikamoo and marahaba).
misconceptions.cause: The child knows both words but not who says which.
misconceptions.reveals: Greeting and reply asked in turn.
misconceptions.help: The younger person greets first; the elder replies.
misconceptions.feedback: Mdogo humsalimia mkubwa kwa "shikamoo", na mkubwa hujibu "marahaba".
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls a cousin kaka or dada (or ndugu), or the cousin's parent mama.
misconceptions.cause: The child uses the closest family word.
misconceptions.reveals: Relations beyond brothers and sisters.
misconceptions.help: A cousin is binamu.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtoto wa shangazi au mjomba ni binamu, si kaka wala dada.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 4: Saa na majira)
learning_experiences: kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali k.v. kufungua mitandao ifaayo,
kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayohusu suala lengwa (saa na majira) na inayoafiki kiwango chake,
kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,

kusoma matini kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali inayojumuisha msamiati wa saa (k.v. kasoro dakika..., saa...kamili, saa...na dakika...) na majira (nyakati za siku) (k.v. alfajiri, asubuhi, adhuhuri, alasiri, thenashara, machweo na macheo),
kusoma vifungu vyenye suala lengwa ambavyo alisakura,
kutoa habari kuhusu matini aliyosoma kwa muhtasari na kujibu maswali katika maandishi au mazungumzo na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni njia zipi unazoweza kupata matini za kusoma katika vifaa vya kidijitali?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kusakura na kusoma matini.
Hamu ya kujifunza: mwanafunzi anapotafuta matini za kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposakura vifungu vyenye habari kuhusu saa na majira na kuwatolea wenzake habari za matini yenyewe.
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapowasiliana na wenzake kutoa habari kuhusu matini aliyosoma kwa muhtasari.

skills.name: Zingatia hatua za kiusalama unapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali
skills.mastery: Chooses the safe step when using a phone, tablet or computer (keep the password secret, ask an adult before an unknown link, use a safe site) and not the unsafe one, in 8 of 10 new situations.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Shares a password or a personal detail with a friend or a stranger.
misconceptions.cause: The child thinks sharing is friendly.
misconceptions.reveals: Safe and unsafe steps for a password.
misconceptions.help: Ask who can use your account if they have the password.
misconceptions.feedback: Nenosiri ni siri yako. Usimpe mtu mwingine, hata rafiki, ila mzazi au mlezi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Opens every link in a message from someone he does not know.

example.question: Ujumbe usiojulikana una kiungo cha zawadi. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child is curious and likes a prize.
misconceptions.reveals: An unknown message with a link.
misconceptions.help: Ask who sent it and whether you asked for it.
misconceptions.feedback: Viungo kutoka kwa watu usiowajua vinaweza kuwa hatari. Mwonyeshe mtu mzima kabla ya kuvifungua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Searches on any site and gives details to a site that asks for them.

example.question: Unatafuta kifungu cha kusoma. Utumie tovuti ipi?
example.wrong_answer: Tovuti inayotaka jina na nambari ya simu yangu
example.correct_answer: Tovuti ya shule au maktaba iliyopendekezwa na mwalimu

misconceptions.cause: The child does not ask who runs the site.
misconceptions.reveals: Safe and unsafe sites.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the site needs your personal details to read.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tovuti salama zilizopendekezwa na mwalimu au mzazi, na usitoe maelezo yako binafsi.

skills.name: Tambua muundo wa baruapepe
skills.mastery: Names the parts of an email (anayepokea, mada, salamu, ujumbe, hitimisho, jina la mwandishi) and puts the right words in the right part, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the layout of a friendly letter (address, date in the corner) for an email.

example.question: Anwani ya mpokeaji kwenye baruapepe huandikwa wapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the letter layout and uses it for the email.
misconceptions.reveals: Layout of letter and email compared.
misconceptions.help: In an email, the address goes in a box at the top.
misconceptions.feedback: Baruapepe ina sehemu ya "Kwa" kwa anwani ya mpokeaji, na sehemu ya mada. Si kama barua ya karatasi yenye anwani kona.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the message in the subject line, or leaves the subject empty.

example.question: Sehemu ya mada huandikwa nini?
example.correct_answer: Kichwa kifupi kinachosema ujumbe unahusu nini

misconceptions.cause: The child does not see the subject as a title.
misconceptions.reveals: Subject and message mixed.
misconceptions.help: The subject is a short title, like a heading.
misconceptions.feedback: Mada ni kichwa kifupi cha baruapepe. Ujumbe wote huandikwa katika mwili wa baruapepe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the greeting after the message or the name before the closing.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the usual order of the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: Parts of the email in a mixed order.
misconceptions.help: Salamu begins it; the name ends it.
misconceptions.feedback: Mpangilio wa baruapepe: anayepokea, mada, salamu, ujumbe, hitimisho, jina la mwandishi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli ya I-ZI (Theme 4: Saa na majira)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya ngeli ya I-ZI katika sentensi kwa kuvipigia mstari daftarini au kuvikoleza rangi katika tarakilishi,
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya I-ZI kwenye kadi, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu la maneno (k.v. nguo- nguo, ndizi- ndizi, ndoo-ndoo na nyumba-nyumba),
kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI katika sentensi akiwa peke yake au katika vikundi,
kusikiliza usomaji wa sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI kutoka kwenye tepurekoda au kinasasauti,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI akiwa peke yake au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,
kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia viambishi vya nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, utajuaje viambishi vipatanishi vya ngeli ya I-ZI kwenye sentensi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotumia nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI katika sentensi akiwa katika vikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI.
Uwazaji wa kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapowaza kwa kina kuhusu sentensi sahihi katika ngeli ya I-ZI.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua viambishi vya ngeli ya I-ZI katika sentensi na kuvikoleza rangi.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi yake kikamilifua kama vile kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia viambishi vya nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wengine kwenye vikundi.
Amani: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutunga sentensi.
sub_strands.pcis: Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake katika kazi ya vikundi.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kutambua na kutumia nomino katika ngeli ya I-ZI na somo la English kwa sababu somo hili hufundisha utambuzi na matumizi ya ngeli mbalimbali za nomino..

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vipatanishi vya ngeli ya I-ZI katika sentensi
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya I-ZI ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine
kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kuonea fahari matumizi ya nomino katika ngeli ya I-ZI katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya I-ZI kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to I-ZI (nyumba, meza, barabara, taa, simu), gives the subject prefix i- for one and zi- for many, and makes the plural of a sentence, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses zi- with one noun of I-ZI.
misconceptions.cause: The child has fixed zi- as "the prefix of I-ZI" and does not tell one from many.
misconceptions.reveals: One and many in the same family of questions.
misconceptions.help: Count: is it one or many?
misconceptions.feedback: Nyumba moja ni umoja. Kiambishi cha umoja cha ngeli ya I-ZI ni i-: nyumba imeanguka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses i- with many nouns of I-ZI.
misconceptions.cause: The noun has the same form for one and many, so the child does not see that it is plural.
misconceptions.reveals: Plural nouns that look the same as the singular.
misconceptions.help: Look at the other words: nyingi, mbili. They say many.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za I-ZI zina umbo moja katika umoja na wingi. Maneno mengine ya sentensi, kama "nyingi", yanaonyesha ni wingi, kwa hiyo tunatumia zi-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses ki-/vi- with a noun of I-ZI because it is a thing.
misconceptions.cause: The child links "thing" with ki-vi and does not check the class.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap with the ki-vi prefixes as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Meza inapatana na kitabu au na nyumba?"
misconceptions.feedback: Si kila kitu hutumia ki-/vi-. Meza, nyumba na barabara ni za ngeli ya I-ZI, kwa hiyo wingi hutumia zi-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes the plural of an I-ZI noun by adding ma- or a plural prefix (manyumba, mezazi).
misconceptions.cause: The child thinks every noun must change to show many.
misconceptions.reveals: Plural sentences with a changed noun and with an unchanged noun.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether this noun has a different plural form.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za I-ZI haziongezi kiambishi katika wingi. Tunabadilisha viambishi vya upatanisho: nyumba zote ni kubwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika kikundi.

outcomes.text: kutambua methali zinazohusu bidii ili kuzitofautisha na aina zingine za methali

skills.name: Tambua na eleza maana ya methali za bidii
skills.mastery: Completes a methali about hard work (haba na haba hujaza kibaba) and says what it means, and does not read it word for word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using a methali when speaking (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Reads the methali word for word.

example.question: Mchumia juani hulia kivulini. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Anayefanya kazi kwa bidii hufurahia matunda yake baadaye

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know that a methali carries a second meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: A meaning question with a literal option.
misconceptions.help: Ask what lesson the methali teaches.
misconceptions.feedback: Methali haisemi maana yake wazi. Mchumia juani hulia kivulini ina maana kwamba anayefanya kazi kwa bidii atapumzika na kufurahia matunda yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the lesson of another methali.

example.question: Haba na haba hujaza kibaba. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Vitu vidogo vikiongezwa polepole huwa vingi

misconceptions.cause: The child knows methali but swaps their lessons.
misconceptions.reveals: The meaning of a different methali as an option.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the words say about little and little.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila methali ina funzo lake. Haba na haba hujaza kibaba inafundisha kwamba kidogo kidogo hujaza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Completes the methali with a word that does not belong to it.
misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the beginning but not the end.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap where a plausible wrong ending is an option.
misconceptions.help: Say the whole methali again from the beginning.
misconceptions.feedback: Methali hubaki jinsi ilivyo. Mwisho sahihi ni kibaba: haba na haba hujaza kibaba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

outcomes.text: kutambua mizani na vina katika shairi ili kuvibainisha
kusoma shairi akizingatia vina, mizani na ujumbe ili kuimarisha ufahamu
kuchangamkia kusoma shairi akizingatia mapigo ya sauti

skills.name: Tambua mizani na vina katika shairi
skills.mastery: Counts the mizani (syllables) in a line by counting vowel sounds, and finds the vina (the matching endings of lines), and does not count words or letters, in 8 of 10 new lines.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Counts the words of the line, not the mizani.
misconceptions.cause: The child counts what he can see.
misconceptions.reveals: A line with few words and many mizani.
misconceptions.help: Clap each sound: ma-ma-a-ni-pi-ka.
misconceptions.feedback: Mizani ni silabi, yaani sehemu za sauti. Hesabu silabi (ma-ma a-na-pi-ka), si maneno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Counts letters, not mizani.
misconceptions.cause: The child counts the letters.
misconceptions.reveals: A line with an option equal to its letter count.
misconceptions.help: Count vowels: each vowel starts a new silabi in Kiswahili.
misconceptions.feedback: Mizani si herufi. Kwa kawaida kila irabu huanza silabi: ne-nda shu-le ni mizani 5.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Looks at the start of the lines, not the end, to find vina.

example.question: Vina vya mishororo hii ni vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the beginnings.
misconceptions.reveals: Lines with matching endings only.
misconceptions.help: Vina are the endings that sound alike.
misconceptions.feedback: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana katika mishororo. Tazama mwisho wa kila mshororo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says the whole last word must be the same for the lines to rhyme.
misconceptions.cause: The child thinks vina means the same word.
misconceptions.reveals: Two lines that end differently but with the same sound.
misconceptions.help: Say both endings aloud and listen to the last sounds.
misconceptions.feedback: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana, si neno lilelile. Shambani na nyumbani zina vina -ani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Miscounts the mizani by one, missing a vowel (the double vowel in bidii counted as one).

example.question: Mshororo "Soma kwa bidii" una mizani mingapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child counts "ii" or "ua" as one sound.
misconceptions.reveals: A line with a double vowel.
misconceptions.help: Clap each vowel: bi-di-i has three.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila irabu ni silabi tofauti: bidii ni bi-di-i, yaani mizani 3. Hesabu kila irabu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

kuandika insha ya maelezo (k.v. kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU katika sentensi akiwa na wenzake,

kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU akiwa peke yake au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya KU-KU kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows that a verbal noun (kusoma, kucheza, kula) is in KU-KU, takes ku- as its subject prefix, and has no plural, and does not agree it with a- or u-, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Agrees a verbal noun with a- (a person) instead of ku-.
misconceptions.cause: The child thinks of the person who reads, not of the action.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap with a-, u-, i- and ku- as options.
misconceptions.help: The first word is kusoma, which begins with ku-.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za KU-KU hupatana na ku-: kusoma kunapendeza. A- ni ya mtu mmoja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Agrees a verbal noun with u- or i- as with U-I.
misconceptions.cause: The child pairs ku- nouns with prefixes of the classes he knows best.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap with u-, i- and ku- as options.
misconceptions.help: Say the sentence with the prefix that is the same as the noun starts with.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi-jina hupatana na ku-, kama kinavyoanza: kucheza kunafurahisha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a plural (makusoma, vikusoma) to a verbal noun.
misconceptions.cause: The child thinks every noun has a plural.
misconceptions.reveals: A plural question where the right answer is that nothing changes.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether you can say "makusoma".
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za KU-KU hazina wingi tofauti. Kusoma hubaki kusoma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

kueleza maana ya maneno matatu yenye maana sawa akiwa na wenzake,

skills.name: Tambua visawe
skills.mastery: Picks the word with almost the same meaning (furaha-bashasha, haraka-upesi) and does not pick the opposite, a related word or a look-alike, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Picks the opposite where the same meaning is asked.
misconceptions.cause: The child links furaha and huzuni because they go together.
misconceptions.reveals: A synonym question with the opposite as an option.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the two words mean the same.
misconceptions.feedback: Visawe ni maneno yenye maana sawa. Furaha na huzuni ni vinyume, si visawe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word about the same topic but with a different meaning.
misconceptions.cause: The child picks what goes with the word, not what means the same.
misconceptions.reveals: A related word as an option.
misconceptions.help: Could you swap the two words in a sentence and keep the same meaning?
misconceptions.feedback: Neno linalohusiana na jingine si lazima liwe na maana sawa nalo. Kisawe cha huzuni ni simanzi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word.
misconceptions.cause: The child goes by the first letters.
misconceptions.reveals: A look-alike word as an option.
misconceptions.help: Say what each word means.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno yanaweza kuanza kwa herufi zilezile na yasiwe na maana sawa. Kisawe cha haraka ni upesi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua na elewa mchezo wa kuigiza
skills.mastery: Tells a play from a story (names of speakers, words spoken, directions in brackets), says what a word in the play means, and answers questions about it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Reads the words in brackets (what to do on stage) as words a character says.

example.question: Maelekezo ya jukwaani katika igizo ni yapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads a play as a story.
misconceptions.reveals: A play with brackets and spoken lines.
misconceptions.help: Brackets tell the actor what to do, not what to say.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno yaliyo kwenye mabano ni maelekezo ya kitendo, si maneno ya mhusika. Hayasomwi kama mazungumzo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell a play from a story.

example.question: Ni kipi kati ya hivi ni igizo?

misconceptions.cause: The child sees a short text and does not look at the form.
misconceptions.reveals: A play and a story on the same event.
misconceptions.help: Look for the speaker names with a colon.
misconceptions.feedback: Igizo huonyesha jina la mhusika, nukta mbili, kisha maneno anayosema. Hadithi huelezwa na msimulizi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a character who did not say the line.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not follow the names before the colons.
misconceptions.reveals: A who-said-it question.
misconceptions.help: Find the line and read the name before it.
misconceptions.feedback: Jina lililo mbele ya nukta mbili ndilo la mtu anayesema maneno yaliyofuata.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a wrong detail of the play (the place, the thing bought).
misconceptions.cause: The child remembers a place named near the question.
misconceptions.reveals: A where-or-what question with another detail of the play.
misconceptions.help: Find the line where it is said.
misconceptions.feedback: Rudi kwenye igizo na utafute mstari unaotaja jibu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong meaning of a word in the play.

example.question: Neno "kuandamana" lina maana gani katika igizo?

misconceptions.cause: The child guesses from the look of the word.
misconceptions.reveals: A meaning question for a word in the play.
misconceptions.help: Read the line where the word is used and think who goes with whom.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana ya neno hutokana na mstari lilimotumika katika igizo. Soma mstari huo tena.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua na tumia kauli za kutendewa, kutendeka na kutendana
skills.mastery: Tells the three verb forms apart (kutendewa: done for or to someone, kutendeka: can be done or becomes done, kutendana: done to each other) and picks the one a sentence needs, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Mixes kutendeka (can be done, becomes done) with kutendewa (done for someone).
misconceptions.cause: The endings -ika and -ewa both change the verb and look alike.
misconceptions.reveals: Verb forms that differ in meaning: done for someone, can be done.
misconceptions.help: Ask: is someone helped, or can the thing simply be done?
misconceptions.feedback: Kutendeka huonyesha kitu kinaweza kutendwa au kinatendeka chenyewe, kama kuvunjika. Kutendewa huonyesha kitendo kimefanyiwa mtu, kama kupikiwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves the verb in its base form where each does it to the other (wanasalimu for wanasalimiana).
misconceptions.cause: The child keeps the base verb and does not show that each does it to the other.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap that needs "to each other".
misconceptions.help: Ask whether they do it to each other.
misconceptions.feedback: Kutendana huonyesha watu wawili au zaidi wanafanyiana kitendo kimoja: kusalimiana, kupendana, kusaidiana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves the verb unchanged (soma) where an ending is needed (somewa, someka).

example.question: Mama alimpikia mtoto uji. Mtoto ___ uji na mama.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not hear the change in meaning an ending brings.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap that needs a changed verb.
misconceptions.help: Ask whom the action is done for or by.
misconceptions.feedback: Hapa kitenzi lazima kibadilike kwa kiambishi ili kuonyesha kinachotokea: mama alipikiwa chakula.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
